A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the knowledge of the climate change issue is not as easily transferred within clusters as one might think.

we have shown the value of cluster theory for understanding knowledge exchange about climate change.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the wine cluster, while providing a useful platform for the exchange of knowledge, does not seem to provide a complete solution.
cluster theory, while providing a useful conceptual lens for examining the climate change issue, does not appear to be able to predict the flow of knowledge in the context of climate change.
the wine industry, while being highly cluster-entrenched, does not appear to have a strong propensity to exchange knowledge about the climate change issue, at least not in our sample of firms.
